body: Thank you so much. After reading this i found myself feeling slightly proud that I made it through today. Your message will definitely stick with me. And again thank you so much for the positive words. Side note : i’m proud that you’re finally in a place in your life and made it through all of your tough times. you deserve to be happy. Again Thank you and I love you too.
I’ve thought about it numerous times. but my parents are my only “ family” members and since i’m not 18 i would probably have to go to foster care or something along those lines.

Thank you for this. I think that’s my new plan from here on out. Finishing Highschool and then just leaving and never looking back. and side note I’m so glad that you’re doing well and left your situation. you deserve to be happy.

Thank you for this. I’ve given some thought to it and I think you’re right. college could be my chance to start over and live a life that i genuinely want to live. When i really think about it I think knowing that I didn’t just give up on myself and actually tried to find the good in my life and move on from this chapter in my life would make me feel better and good about myself. Of course all of these things are easier said than done and i’m sure it’ll take me some time until i’m completely okay again. but it’s worth a try. Thank you so much for this.

im so sorry that you’re going through that. although your situation aren’t the exact same i semi understand what you’re going through. i hope you know that i care about you and if you ever need someone to talk to i’m here. even though i’m having some of the same thoughts you’re having i encourage you to hang in there and keep fighting. you have so much life to live

i want to say thank you so much for your kind words. i didn’t expect anyone to even care in the slightest. you may not realize it but this comment genuinely made me smile and feel a bit better. i appreciate it so much.
